candidates.title: The Can We Leave Language
candidates.suggested_text_hook: we have a whole language for "can we leave?"
candidates.why_people_may_share: The send-trigger is instant: every couple has a private exit signal at weddings, family dinners, office parties, or friend gatherings. Someone sends this because it says, softly and safely, "you and I are a team in public."
candidates.why_people_may_comment: It baits specific comments: "the eyebrow raise," "the foot tap," "ours is the keys sound," "he knows from one look."
candidates.likely_audience_reaction: Babe this is us. No caption needed, just a tag and an accusation with affection.

candidates.title: Still Mad, Still Careful
candidates.suggested_text_hook: we were still mad. he still brought my water.
candidates.why_people_may_share: This travels because it gives couples language for the tiny repair gestures after a small fight. Sending it is a confession, not a performance: "I noticed you do this."
candidates.why_people_may_comment: People will comment with their own soft repair rituals: chargers, medicine, blankets, saving food, locking the door for them even mid-argument.
candidates.likely_audience_reaction: Guilty. Annoyed but smiling. A little emotionally attacked in the correct way.

candidates.title: The Party Debrief
candidates.suggested_text_hook: we left the party. the meeting continued.
candidates.why_people_may_share: The send reason is beautifully specific: couples who cannot leave any social event without a full post-game analysis. It turns gossip into intimacy without making them look cruel.
candidates.why_people_may_comment: Comment bait is strong: "parking lot debrief," "shoes still on debrief," "we do minutes of the meeting," "the ride home is the real event."
candidates.likely_audience_reaction: Why are we like this. Also please never stop doing this with me.

top_pick.title: The Can We Leave Language
top_pick.reason: Best pure send. It has the fastest recognition window, the clearest partner-tag reason, and the lowest social risk. The sender is not criticizing their partner; they are celebrating their secret team language.

engagement_rationale.send_trigger: A private couple signal that viewers can identify in under three seconds.
engagement_rationale.tag_reason: One partner can tag the other as proof that their exact silent signal exists.
engagement_rationale.why_this_is_not_like_only: The hook names a shared behavior so specifically that the natural action is to send it to the person who participates in it, not just admire the artwork.

distribution_risks.risk: If drawn too broadly, it may become a generic party scene.
distribution_risks.mitigation: Make the visual proof the couple's eye contact and tiny exit signal, with the room fading into soft background noise.

distribution_risks.risk: Could read as social anxiety if handled too heavy.
distribution_risks.mitigation: Keep the expression playful, conspiratorial, and affectionate.

distribution_risks.risk: Text must stay phone-readable and not feel like a quote card.
distribution_risks.mitigation: Use warm-charcoal handwritten text baked into upper-middle negative space with the couple scene doing the emotional work.
